gloss: one's later years; last years of life

definitions.gloss: one's later years; last years of life; twilight years
definitions.explanation: The final period of a person's life, especially the years leading up to old age and death. Often used when discussing a notable person's later career or final accomplishments.

examples.japanese: {晩年|ばんねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: He spent his later years in his hometown.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{晩年|ばんねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The painter's late-period works are on display.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{晩年|ばんねん}になって⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}め、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}っていた→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
examples.english: In his later years my grandfather took up calligraphy and held a brush every day.

notes:
Refers specifically to the last stage of a life, not just "old age" in general. Usually used about someone already deceased or about the final phase of a long career.
